slides.say: Use effect takes two things: a setup function, and an optional list of dependencies.
Setup connects. It can return a cleanup function that disconnects. The array lists the values the Effect uses.

slides.text: After a commit, React runs setup. If a dependency changed: cleanup with old values, then setup with new ones.
slides.say: React runs setup after the commit. When a dependency changes, it runs cleanup with the old values, then setup with the new ones.

slides.text: Not caused by a click? React usually lets the browser paint first.
slides.say: If no click or other interaction caused it, React usually lets the browser paint the screen first, then runs your Effect.

slides.text: Top level only. Returns nothing. Never runs on the server.
slides.say: Call it at the top level. It returns nothing. And Effects only run on the client, never during server rendering.
